blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ABS-CBN Corp. saw its losses widen by nearly a third in the first nine months of 2026, as weaker advertising demand and a shrinking cable subscriber base were further aggravated by “challenging market conditions” In a disclosure on Friday, the media company reported a consolidated net loss of P2.95 billion from January to September, 32 percent wider than the P2.24-billion loss recorded a year earlier. READ: ABS-CBN’s financial bleeding worsens During the period, ABS-CBN’s consolidated revenues reached P10.51 billion, but unfavorable market conditions ultimately chipped away at its gains. “Global economic and geopolitical developments, the pace of domestic economic […]...
